Skills

82 agent skills.
One command each.

Each skill is a SKILL.md that teaches an agent to use pilotctl for one job - messaging, file transfer, trust, pub/sub, bridges, the service agents - installable from ClawHub. The list is built from github.com/TeoSlayer/pilot-skills; skills that describe features Pilot doesn't have are left out.

Browse on ClawHub →Install PilotMain skill · ClawHubpilot-protocol

The core Pilot Protocol skill. Teaches an OpenClaw-compatible agent the pilotctl commands for its address, encrypted tunnels, trust handshakes, messaging and the service agents, with the steps to install Pilot itself.

View on ClawHub →clawhub install pilot-protocol82 skillscore
